Pointsman の HTTP API です。どのリクエストにも、ヘッダー `Authorization: Bearer <token>` で API トークンを付けます。OpenAPI を読むツール向けの完全な定義は [openapi.yaml](../../../openapi.yaml) にあります。

コードから取り込んだ説明文は英語のままです。

## POST /v1/decide/{profile}

Get a decision from a profile.

| パラメーター | 場所 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `profile` | path | はい |   |
| `version` | query | いいえ | Profile version. The latest version when not given. |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | いいえ | A repeated request with the same key from the same client gets the decision already logged, when the request is the same (profile and version, state, ref, decisions); a different request with the same key is refused (409 idempotency_conflict). Ignored for test tokens, whose decisions are not logged. |

リクエストボディ: `DecideRequest`(JSON)

| ステータス | 説明 | ボディ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | The decision | `Decision` (application/json) |
| 400 | Error | `Error` (application/json) |
| 401 | Missing, malformed, unknown or revoked token. | `Error` (application/json) |
| 403 | The token may not use this profile. | `Error` (application/json) |
| 404 | Error | `Error` (application/json) |
| 409 | `resolved_by_person`: the decision this one would replace was resolved by a person, and a person's answer stays (docs/decision-chains.md). `idempotency_conflict`: the Idempotency-Key was used for a different request. | `Error` (application/json) |
| 500 | Error | `Error` (application/json) |
| 502 | Error | `Error` (application/json) |

## GET /v1/decisions/{id}

Get a logged decision with its feedback.

| `id` | path | はい |   |

## POST /v1/decisions/{id}/feedback

Correct the answers of a decision.

Corrections are checked against the profile version the decision used.
A decision can get feedback more than once; all of it is kept.

| パラメーター | 場所 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | はい |   |

リクエストボディ: `FeedbackRequest`(JSON)

| --- | --- | --- |
| 204 | Feedback stored |   |
| 400 | Error | `Error` (application/json) |
| 401 | Missing, malformed, unknown or revoked token. | `Error` (application/json) |
| 403 | A test token, which may only decide. | `Error` (application/json) |
| 404 | Unknown decision, or one whose profile this token may not use. | `Error` (application/json) |
| 409 | The profile version of the decision is no longer available. | `Error` (application/json) |
| 500 | Error | `Error` (application/json) |

## GET /v1/stats/{profile}

What happened to a profile's decisions in the last days.

Counts only, no single decisions or states: decisions per action, the
review queue (pending, resolved, the final actions people chose), and
decisions where a person corrected at least one answer. The window
applies to when a decision was made; a later resolution or correction
of such a decision counts with it.

| パラメーター | 場所 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `profile` | path | はい |   |
| `days` | query | いいえ | The window, from 1 to 90 days back from now (default 7). |

| ステータス | 説明 | ボディ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | The counts | `ProfileStats` (application/json) |
| 400 | Error | `Error` (application/json) |
| 401 | Missing, malformed, unknown or revoked token. | `Error` (application/json) |
| 403 | The token may not use this profile. | `Error` (application/json) |
| 404 | Unknown profile. | `Error` (application/json) |
| 500 | Error | `Error` (application/json) |

## GET /v1/reviews

List decisions waiting for a human review.

Decisions with action `review` that are not resolved yet, oldest first (at most 100), for the profiles this token may use.

| パラメーター | 場所 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `profile` | query | いいえ |   |

| ステータス | 説明 | ボディ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Pending reviews | object (application/json) |
| 401 | Missing, malformed, unknown or revoked token. | `Error` (application/json) |
| 403 | The token may not use this profile, or it is a test token (it may only decide). | `Error` (application/json) |
| 500 | Error | `Error` (application/json) |

## POST /v1/reviews/{id}/resolve

Resolve a pending review.

Sets the final action and answers. Answers in `correct` replace the
model's (source `human`); the others are kept (source `model`).
`correct` is also stored as feedback. When the decision has a
`callback_url`, the final answer is sent there (see "Callbacks").

| パラメーター | 場所 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | はい |   |

リクエストボディ: `ResolveRequest`(JSON)

| ステータス | 説明 | ボディ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Resolved | `Resolution` (application/json) |
| 400 | Error | `Error` (application/json) |
| 401 | Missing, malformed, unknown or revoked token. | `Error` (application/json) |
| 403 | A test token, which may only decide. | `Error` (application/json) |
| 404 | Unknown decision, or one whose profile this token may not use. | `Error` (application/json) |
| 409 | The decision has no pending review (not a review, or already resolved), or its profile version is gone. | `Error` (application/json) |
| 500 | Error | `Error` (application/json) |

## GET /v1/profiles/{id}/graph

The decision graph a profile belongs to, for DMN tools.

The profile, the profiles it requires and the ones that require it
(docs/decision-chains.md), among the profiles this token may use, as
a DMN decision requirements graph. Only the graph: no decision logic.
With `format=dmn`, DMN 1.3 XML with DMNDI shapes, which DMN tools
(bpmn.io dmn-js, Camunda Modeler, Apache KIE) open. Not for test tokens.

| パラメーター | 場所 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | はい |   |
| `format` | query | いいえ | json (the graph), dmn (DMN 1.3 XML with DMNDI) or svg (a small diagram in the style of the datamodels.jp diagrams). |
| `lang` | query | いいえ | The language of the svg diagram's text. |

| ステータス | 説明 | ボディ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | The graph | `DecisionGraph` (application/json) |
| 400 | Error | `Error` (application/json) |
| 401 | Missing, malformed, unknown or revoked token. | `Error` (application/json) |
| 403 | The token may not use this profile (also a test token). | `Error` (application/json) |
| 404 | Error | `Error` (application/json) |
| 500 | Error | `Error` (application/json) |

## GET /v1/profiles/{id}/explain

A profile in plain sentences.

The profile as plain sentences in English or Japanese, for the people
who approve it (docs/profile-format.md#explain): which model answers,
what it sees, the questions, facts and earlier decisions, and each rule
as "If ..., the action is ...". The rules are read with the engine's own
parser. A required profile out of this token's scope is not named, and a
rule that reads it is shown as written. Test tokens may use it too: it
reads no decisions.

| パラメーター | 場所 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | はい |   |
| `version` | query | いいえ | A published version; the latest when not given. |
| `lang` | query | いいえ |   |
| `format` | query | いいえ | json (the parts), or text (Markdown, to show as it is). |

| ステータス | 説明 | ボディ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | The explanation | `ProfileExplanation` (application/json) |
| 400 | Error | `Error` (application/json) |
| 401 | Missing, malformed, unknown or revoked token. | `Error` (application/json) |
| 403 | The token may not use this profile. | `Error` (application/json) |
| 404 | Error | `Error` (application/json) |
| 500 | Error | `Error` (application/json) |

## POST /v1/profiles/{id}/replay

Try a changed policy on the logged decisions.

What a changed policy would have decided on the newest logged decisions
of a published version (docs/profile-format.md#replay). Policy only: the
logged answers and facts are used, no model is called, and questions,
facts and requires must stay the same (send them to have them checked).
Earlier decisions are read from the snapshot kept with each decision; a
new rule that reads a value the snapshot did not keep is unknown there,
and the decision is counted as inexact. The token must be allowed to use
the profile and every profile it requires. Not for test tokens.

| パラメーター | 場所 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | はい |   |

リクエストボディ: object(JSON)

| ステータス | 説明 | ボディ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | The replay | `ReplayResult` (application/json) |
| 400 | Error | `Error` (application/json) |
| 401 | Missing, malformed, unknown or revoked token. | `Error` (application/json) |
| 403 | The token may not use this profile or a profile it requires (also a test token). | `Error` (application/json) |
| 404 | Error | `Error` (application/json) |
| 409 | The draft's questions, facts or requires differ from the version (not_policy_only). | `Error` (application/json) |
| 500 | Error | `Error` (application/json) |

## スキーマ

### DecideRequest

| フィールド | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | string \| object \| array | はい | What the model decides about: free text, or any JSON object or array. When the profile has an `input` mapping, this is the raw client payload the mapping reads from. |
| `ref` | string | いいえ | The client's reference for this decision, for example an issue id. |
| `callback_url` | string | いいえ | Where to send the final answer after a human review (https only). |
| `decisions` | object | いいえ | For a profile with `requires` (docs/decision-chains.md): the ids of the earlier decisions, by the names in `requires`. They are read from the decision log and must be of the named profile, in the token's scope, with this request's `ref` (then required) and from the same client; every other case gives the same 400. An optional one that was made for an older decision than one given here is left out (it is missing from `requires` in the answer). Not for test tokens. |

| `description` | string | はい |   |

| `input` | string | はい | What the model sees of the request. |
| `questions` | string[] | はい |   |
| `facts` | string[] | はい |   |
| `requires` | string[] | はい |   |
| `rules` | object[] | はい | In order; the first rule that matches gives the action. |
| `order` | string | はい | How the rules are checked. |
| `default` | string | はい | The action when no rule matches |
| `people` | string[] | はい | Which actions a person checks |
| `notes` | string[] | はい |   |

### ReplayResult

A changed policy replayed on logged decisions (docs/profile-format.md#replay).

| フィールド | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `profile` | string | はい |   |
| `version` | integer | はい | The version whose decisions were replayed. |
| `replayed` | integer | はい | Decisions replayed exactly; all other numbers count only these. |
| `from` | string \| null | はい | The oldest replayed decision. |
| `to` | string \| null | はい | The newest replayed decision. |
| `inexact` | integer | はい | Decisions not replayed because a new rule reads a value of an earlier decision that was not kept. |
| `skipped` | integer | はい | Decisions not replayed because an answer the new rules read is not in the log. |
| `changed` | integer | はい | Decisions whose action would change. |
| `actions` | object | はい |   |
| `transitions` | object[] | はい |   |
| `people` | object | はい |   |
| `changes` | object[] | はい | Up to 50 changed decisions, newest first. |
